cohort: Infants born at 22-29 weeks of gestation treated at Saitama Medical Center, Saitama Medical University, from 2005 to 2020, excluding those with severe intraventricular hemorrhage or periventricular leukomalacia.
finding: A high prevalence of severe neurodevelopmental impairment (NDI) was observed, especially among infants born at 22 and 23 weeks of gestation, with lower birth weight, male sex, no antenatal corticosteroid therapy, and abdominal surgery identified as independent risk factors.
birth_weight: N/A (lower birth weight was identified as a risk factor, but no specific weight range for the included cohort is provided)
